## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is described as a pale, spiritual-looking maiden. She presents a striking appearance, looking golden and fair when dressed in silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, Priscilla Grant possesses a lively personality. She is full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside her friends [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) before accepting a teaching position at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school. During a springtime celebration, she joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) on a walk through the woods to explore the forgotten garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md). On another occasion, Priscilla unexpectedly arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) accompanied by the author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), where they enjoyed a meal hosted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). When Priscilla moved to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), she met [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the station and escorted her to their new boarding house. Shortly after registering for classes, Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited Old St. John's Cemetery, where they met and quickly bonded with fellow student [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). Priscilla settled into college life and shared social outings with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie. Before their sophomore year, Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) searched for a house to rent alongside [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), eventually securing Patty's Place from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md). Priscilla moved into Patty's Place with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), and chaperone [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), residing there throughout their remaining years at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as they completed their final examinations and celebrated their graduation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> "It would be too good to be true. Fairy tales don’t happen nowadays. I won’t hope, Anne. The disappointment would be too awful to bear. They’re sure to want more for it than we can afford. Remember, it’s on Spofford Avenue."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Friend P31](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0031)

> "This cake is now what you might call a flat failure. And the cushion is likewise ruined. Never tell me that Friday isn’t unlucky."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P35](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0035)

> "She talks as much about boys as Ruby Gillis does. But it always enrages or sickens me to hear Ruby, whereas I just wanted to laugh good-naturedly at Phil. Now, what is the why of that?"
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Lady P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070)

> “Little did I think the day would ever come when I’d be glad of the sight of a Sloane,” said Priscilla, as they crossed the campus, “but I’d welcome Charlie’s goggle eyes almost ecstatically. At least, they’d be familiar eyes.”
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Lady P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004)

> "Here you are, beloved! And I suppose you’re as tired as I was when I got here Saturday night."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Farewell P11](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became intimate friends while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) together. Their bond has continued through their teaching days and into their time at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), where they share adventures such as outings in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and searching for housing together in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). They frequently confide in each other, celebrate personal milestones, and enjoy deep, poetic conversations about nature and life.

- Friend of — intimate friends at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +17 more</sub>

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla is the niece of Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), a famous author. Priscilla brings her aunt to visit [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), surprising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and arranging for them to host the distinguished writer for dinner.

- Relative of — niece (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>

### [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--priscilla-grant.md)

[Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) acts as the housekeeper and chaperone for Priscilla and her college housemates at Patty's Place. Priscilla warmly welcomed [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) into the home, where they share a cozy and cheerful living arrangement alongside her housemates and cats.

- Friend of — housemates who admired and welcomed her warmly (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051)</sub>

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Jane](../character/jane.md) are friends who share pleasant outings together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Notably, they explored the local woods alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate Anne's birthday, where they discovered Hester Gray's hidden garden and spent the afternoon conversing and eating by a brook.

- Friend of — friends who discovered Hester Gray's garden together (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Time P16](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0016)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phil-gordon--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla met Philippa "[Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md)" Gordon at Old St. John's Cemetery during their first days at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), where they quickly bonded despite Phil's frivolous nature. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) later begged to join Priscilla, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) as a housemate, becoming one of their regular companions for college social outings and walks around [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).

- Friend of — college friends and companions (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Summons P14](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0014)</sub>

### [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

Priscilla and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) were school chums at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) who later reunited to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) together. [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) initiated the idea for the two of them, along with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), to rent a house in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) for their sophomore year with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), resulting in their shared life at Patty's Place.

- Friend of — former school chums at Queen's Academy (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
